description: This source file defines the DeleteUserCommandHandler class which handles delete user commands in the application, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and utilizing the AppUserWritePlatformService to perform user deletion.

classes.name: DeleteUserCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles delete user commands by invoking the user write platform service to delete the specified user.

methods.name: DeleteUserCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the user write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete user command by calling the deleteUser method on the write platform service with the provided command's entity ID.
